items.t: Engine shuts off and shifts into Park on the 5.7L eTorque
items.job: Diagnose stalling, test 12V and 48V batteries, update software
items.note: A 48-volt battery or motor-generator replacement costs much more; these should be under warranty on most vehicles.

items.t: Thermostat sticks closed and the 3.0L overheats
items.note: Covered by bulletin 09-006-25 or notice 26B on many vehicles built through Oct 1, 2024.

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.note: Usually covered by the factory warranty on 2024 models.

items.t: Shifts into Park or sets the parking brake while moving
items.job: Diagnose electrical fault and update software

items.t: Battery keeps going dead
items.job: Test and replace main or auxiliary battery

items.t: Power steering assist cuts out
items.job: Diagnose and repair or replace electric steering gear
items.note: A full steering rack runs about $2,750-$2,850 at a shop; software or wiring fixes cost far less.

items.t: Brake pedal sinks or braking fades
items.job: Diagnose brake system and replace brake booster or module

items.t: Automatic emergency braking slams on with nothing there
items.job: Check and recalibrate front camera and radar sensors

items.t: Vibration or wobble at highway speeds
items.note: Tires or wheels that are out of round cost extra.

items.t: Fuel pump failure causes stalling
Gas smell from fuel leak
items.job: Find and repair fuel leak at injector or line

items.t: Touchscreens freeze, go blank or reboot
items.note: Replacing a screen or radio module costs much more.

items.t: Sun visor breaks or falls down
Seat lumbar support over-inflates
items.job: Replace seat lumbar pump or control

items.t: Climate settings change on their own
items.job: Climate control diagnosis and software update

items.t: Air suspension raises or lowers on its own
items.job: Diagnose and repair air suspension leak, sensor or valve
items.note: A new air spring or compressor costs more.

items.t: Sunroof glass shatters
items.note: Often covered by auto glass insurance.
